_read_this_first.currency: USD, nominal dollars, 2026 closing assumed (see assumptions.basis_of_computation)
_read_this_first.headline_rule: The five required fields for each deal are computed on the DEAL PRICE ONLY, excluding interest Buyer B would pay on its note. Interest is shown separately in stock_sale_buyer_b.note_interest and in sensitivity.sens_5_interest_and_time_value so that the three asset-sale columns and the stock sale stay comparable.
_read_this_first.all_figures_computed: every number below is derived in memo.md section 6 with the arithmetic shown; nothing is plugged or forced to balance.

character_by_class.note: gain assumed nil because buyer allocated face value; see sensitivity.sens_1_cash_method_receivables
ordinary in any allocation; built-in gain at 1/1/2023 shown as 0 in the appraisal ('Other ... 0')

100% IRC 1245 ordinary: depreciation allowed 860,000 exceeds total gain; allocation exceeds the register FMV of 650,000. See sensitivity.sens_3_per_asset_recapture for the ~21,923 that could escape recapture if 900,000 were pro-rated asset by asset.
ordinary to the seller under Rev. Rul. 69-643; the covenant did not exist at 1/1/2023 so it carries no built-in gain
long-term capital gain at shareholder level, but IRC 1374 recognized built-in gain is capped at the 900,000 appraised at 1/1/2023

stock_sale_buyer_b.character_of_gain: entirely long-term capital gain; no IRC 1245 recapture and no IRC 1374 entity-level tax because the corporation disposes of no assets

sec453_installment_deferral.irc_453i_recapture_acceleration: does not apply - there is no IRC 1245 recapture in a stock sale, so the full deferral is available

asset_sale_counter_allocation.saving_arithmetic: 17% x (250,000 moved out of Class V + 300,000 moved out of Class VI) = 0.17 x 550,000 = 93,500

ray_naive_estimate.why_wrong: treats all 3,100,000 as capital gain and ignores the 237,300 IRC 1374 entity-level tax. Real result on Buyer A's own paper: 1,070,000 ordinary + 1,450,000 capital + entity-level tax.

ranking_nominal_price_only.deal: Buyer B stock sale, price only

lone_star_price_needed_to_match_hensley.note: the buyer's 500,000 note is unsecured; those three figures do not price credit risk. Add a risk premium or take the note secured, and the number Lone Star must beat rises.

assumptions.basis_of_computation: nominal dollars, single 2026 closing, no state individual income tax (library: Texas has none); Texas franchise tax on the entity not computed - no rate in the library
assumptions.rates: 37% ordinary, 20% long-term capital gain, 21% entity-level IRC 1374 - all from library/capital_gain_rates.md and library/irc_1374.md
assumptions.irc_1411: assumed not to apply - Ray materially participates in an active trade or business (library/capital_gain_rates.md). If he does not materially participate, 3.8% NIIT would add tax on the gain; not modeled.
assumptions.receivables_basis: assumed tax basis equals the 200,000 carrying value, so no gain on Class III. See sensitivity.sens_1.
assumptions.equipment_basis_and_dep: adjusted basis 240,000 and depreciation allowed 860,000 taken from documents/fixed_asset_register.csv
assumptions.sec1374_scope: recognized built-in gain limited to the 1/1/2023 appraisal: goodwill 900,000 + equipment 230,000 = 1,130,000. The library contains only 1374(a), (b), (d)(7); the (d) definitional rules for 'net recognized built-in gain' (and any inventory or taxable-income limitation) are NOT in the library, so the 237,300 is a library-limited estimate - flagged, not hidden.
assumptions.sec1366f2: the IRC 1374 tax is treated as an entity-level cost in the headline figures; the IRC 1366(f)(2) pass-through loss to Ray is NOT credited because its character is not addressed in the library. See sensitivity.sens_4.
assumptions.liabilities: trade payables, warranty/defect claims and other liabilities are NOT in the numbers for either deal because no amounts were provided - see QUESTIONS.md and sensitivity.sens_6.
assumptions.winding_up: the tax cost of liquidating Brightline Cabinetry LLC after an asset sale is NOT modeled - IRC 331/336 are not in the library.

sens_1_cash_method_receivables.trigger: Brightline reports on the cash method, so the 200,000 of receivables carry zero basis
sens_1_cash_method_receivables.affects: both asset-sale columns only (Buyer B buys the interests, and the receivables stay in the company)

sens_2_escrow.item: Buyer B holds 100,000 of Ray's own money for 12 months, no interest stated
sens_2_escrow.note: plus an unresolved question of whether the escrow is a qualified escrow account for IRC 453 purposes - not in the library

sens_3_per_asset_recapture.item: IRC 1245 applies asset by asset. At the register FMV of 650,000, all 410,000 of equipment gain is ordinary. If the 900,000 were pro-rated across the six assets, about 21,923 would exceed per-asset depreciation and be capital.
sens_3_per_asset_recapture.conclusion: immaterial, and it depends on defending an FMV that the client's own register contradicts

sens_4_sec1366f2_loss_credited.item: if the IRC 1366(f)(2) loss offsets Ray at his 37% ordinary rate, the 237,300 entity tax costs him 149,499 net
sens_4_sec1366f2_loss_credited.effect: Buyer A (counter allocation) closes to within about 5,900 of Buyer B on a nominal price-only basis, but not on a PV basis; character of that loss is not in the library and is therefore not taken in the headline

sens_5_interest_and_time_value.item: discounting all cash at 6% (the note rate) - an assumption, not a client-verified rate

sens_6_liability_shift.item: Buyer B assumes all liabilities known and unknown; Buyer A assumes only scheduled trade payables and leaves the rest with Ray's corporation, including the 237,300 IRC 1374 tax
sens_6_liability_shift.note: cannot be quantified without the payables schedule and claims history; every dollar of retained liability reduces Buyer A's advantage

sens_7_post_recognition_period.item: IRC 1374(d)(7) recognition period = 1/1/2023 through 12/31/2027. An asset sale closing in 2028 carries no entity-level tax.

sens_8_real_property_and_1250.item: if the spray booth or any other Class V item is real property, unrecaptured IRC 1250 gain treatment may apply
sens_8_real_property_and_1250.note: IRC 1250 is NOT in the library - unverified, flagged only

sens_9_sec338h10_336e.item: Buyer B could elect IRC 338(h)(10) or 336(e), which converts the deal to a deemed asset sale; that would pull the whole IRC 1245 / IRC 1374 problem into the stock deal
sens_9_sec338h10_336e.note: the mechanics and consequences are only summarized in library/stock_vs_asset_overview.md; do not let this election be made without recomputing - a 3,100,000-class asset-sale tax result inside a 2,850,000 stock deal would be the worst outcome in this file
